rationale: The short thesis remains intact as SNEX continues to trade near the bottom of its daily range (13.0%) well below a declining session VWAP ($36.56), supported by elevated relative volume (3.42x) and a weakening broader market (SPY -2.13%). Holding allows the dominant downtrend to resume toward the $35.20 target.
